facebook.caption:
5,265 reviews. 4.7 stars. And somehow Mövenpick Resort Waverly Phu Quoc still flies under the radar for most tourists hitting the island.

Beachfront position at Ông Lang. Two restaurants on-site. A full spa. Pool that actually gets morning light.

This is the resort locals recommend when family visits from abroad. Not the flashy one on the billboards.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
